compatibility_notes: Primary Executable International Curriculum Design Style for DesignCraft (Oxford, Cambridge, Family and Friends & Garnet Education). Contains 10 executable page families with 100% bound dynamic text_slots (0 unslotted words), pre-authored graphic frames for image_slots underneath native speech bubbles, and single-level decomposable vector groups (object.group <-> object.ungroup) within A4 15mm safe margins.

design_profile.name: Oxford, Cambridge & Garnet International Style / نمط أكسفورد وكامبريدج وكارنيت
typography: All typography uses native editable Tahoma Regular/Bold frames with explicit leading and automatic paragraph direction (RTL for Arabic, LTR for English). Never rasterize text into images.
Adapt 100% of the 12 declared text slots on every page to the exact requested curriculum subject (e.g. Computer Science / ICT, Science, Math, Languages) and target language.
layout: A4 portrait (210x297 mm) with strict 15 mm safe margins. Every page family uses single-level decomposable vector groups (object.group <-> object.ungroup) with 3-10 labeled part.* atomic objects.

For complete curricula or multi-page books, sequence the 10 families logically: open with international-curriculum-cover and international-scope-sequence, then rotate across garnet-computing-systems-lab, oxford-vocab-story, cambridge-cpa-grammar, oxford-phonics-maze, oxford-song-colours, oxford-skills-time, oxford-fluency-project, and oxford-workbook-print.

Every image slot has an exact pre-authored native graphic frame placed BEFORE overlaid native speech bubbles, number badges, and lyric cards so generated illustrations sit cleanly underneath editable overlays.
pedagogy: Combine Oxford (First Friends, Family and Friends, Oxford International Computing), Cambridge (CPA Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract & Primary Computing), and Garnet Education (Topic-Banner & Systems Progression) methodologies.
Move systematically from visual vocabulary/hardware discovery to systems/IPO/CPA logic, guided skill practice, collaborative lab projects, and print-ready workbook assessment.
illustration: Warm international textbook watercolor-and-ink digital illustration with friendly expressive characters, clear technical/educational objects, and pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds for isolated flashcard cutouts.

For story panels, computer lab scenes, grammar scenes, and song spreads, reserve the top 28% (or right 34% on song spreads) as calm light background space so native vector speech bubbles and cards remain 100% legible.
Strictly NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, and NO speech bubbles inside generated raster pixels.

corrections.before: Repeating a generic layout or leaving stock topic words from another subject when generating a specialized curriculum such as Computer Science (الحاسوب).
corrections.after: Sequence the 10 specialized Oxford, Cambridge & Garnet page families (Cover, Scope & Sequence, Computing Lab/IPO, Vocab & Story, Symbols & Maze, CPA & Rules, Visual & Chant, Skills Time, Fluency & Project, Workbook Print) and adapt 100% of text slots and image prompts to the requested subject.
corrections.reason: Original curriculum page architecture for Computer Science, STEM and Languages; actual educational and visual quality requires human review.
